title: A restaurant in Mexico City
assumptions: A new Mexican S. de R.L. de C.V. opening a restaurant with staff and a fit-out. IMSS's pages refused every read, so the employer registration abstains and names IMSS; it is set aside.

items.name: Company incorporation before a Mexican notary (fedatario público)
items.agency: Notario or corredor público, then the Registro Público de Comercio

items.name: Federal taxpayer registration (RFC) with the SAT
items.quote: Personas morales de nueva creación a través de sus representantes legales
items.quoteEn: Newly created companies, through their legal representatives

items.name: Land use certificate for the activity (uso de suelo)
items.agency: Secretaría de Desarrollo Urbano y Vivienda (SEDUVI)
items.quote: Certificado de Zonificación de uso del suelo para el giro que se pretende operar
items.quoteEn: Land use zoning certificate for the activity to be operated
items.agencyMatch: Secretaría de Desarrollo Urbano y Vivienda

items.name: Notice of operation for a restaurant (impacto vecinal)
items.agency: Mexico City alcaldía, through SEDECO's SIAPEM system
items.quote: presenten por medio del Sistema un Aviso de Funcionamiento para Establecimiento Mercantil de Impacto Vecinal
items.quoteEn: file through the System a Notice of Operation for a Commercial Establishment of Neighbourhood Impact

items.name: Health notice of operation (aviso de funcionamiento) for a food establishment
items.agency: COFEPRIS (or the state health protection authority)
items.quote: Cuando se trate de la notificación de un establecimiento nuevo o de una nueva sucursal.
items.quoteEn: When notifying a new establishment or a new branch.

items.name: Employer registration with the IMSS
items.note: No sentence on the agency's page could be read in this pass: the row abstains and names the office; set aside.
